description: This file defines the SalahRepository class responsible for managing daily prayer records (Salah) in an Android app. It handles storing, retrieving, and updating prayer completion data using shared preferences, as well as providing historical data and counts for prayers completed on specific days.

classes.name: SalahDayRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a record of prayer completion status for a specific day, including the date and a map of prayer names to completion booleans.

classes.name: SalahRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing storage and retrieval of Salah prayer completion data, providing methods for checking, updating, and fetching records and history.

methods.name: getChecklist
methods.description: Returns a map of PrayerName to Boolean indicating if each prayer is completed on the given date.

methods.name: setPrayerCompleted
methods.description: Marks a specific prayer as completed or not on a given date, updating stored records accordingly.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SalahDayRecords for the last specified number of days.

methods.name: countCompleted
methods.description: Counts how many prayers were completed in a given SalahDayRecord.

methods.name: getDayRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the record for a specific date, if it exists.

methods.name: saveAllRecords
methods.description: Persists the list of SalahDayRecords to shared preferences.

methods.name: getAllRecords
methods.description: Loads all stored SalahDayRecords from shared preferences.

methods.name: recordsKey
methods.description: Generates the storage key for records based on user mode and account.
